value.rationale: Sharp disconnected numerical contraction on an exponentially stable but physically transiently expansive Jordan system is a substantive diagnostic boundary: RK4 exactly erases arbitrary shear at a single step, so observing decay or relying on the scalar stability eigenvalue can badly mischaracterize physical amplification. The full parameter classification with square-root onset and inverse-shear narrowing is a motivated exact numerical-stability benchmark, not merely a sample calculation or routine restatement of the continuous-time contractivity bound.
